Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of room (for example, club/lounge level room).

Location.name: Location
Location.definition: Contains the room location information (for example,ocean view, lake view, level, etc.)

BedType.name: Bed Type
BedType.definition: Contain the type of bed in room (for example, single, double, king, etc.)

Guests.name: Guests
Guests.definition: Contains the number of guests in the room.

Adults.name: Adults
Adults.definition: Contains the number of adult guests in the room.

Children.name: Children
Children.definition: Contains the number of child guests in the room.

DailyRate.name: Daily Rate
DailyRate.definition: Daily rate being charged for the room.
